long_biography.plain_text:
Buying the Ellerman shipping-and-brewing group in 1983 changed the scale of Sir David Barclay's partnership with his identical twin, Sir Frederick. They had progressed from teenage painting and decorating to estate agency and hotel redevelopment, learning to extract value from overlooked property. They later sold Ellerman's brewing division for much more than the original purchase price and retained its name for their investment group.

Barclay guarded his privacy even as those acquisitions drew public attention. The brothers settled on Brecqhou in the Channel Islands and rarely gave interviews, while their portfolio grew across luxury hotels, newspapers and home shopping. Both were knighted in 2000 for charitable services, recognition that sat beside an intensely private approach to business and public life.
